verdict.rationale: First-party Teams platform docs describe building agents and chatting with them in Teams, and bots that can initiate and participate in conversations. Supporting docs cover porting Slack Bolt apps, outgoing webhooks that send channel messages to a web service, message streaming, agent slash commands and publishing agents. Together these clearly deliver the core of a conversational AI agent in Teams. missing for 10: explicit evidence of adding the agent to a channel as a member, explicit documentation of @mention-triggered responses in channels, independent or hands-on corroboration.
